identificationModule.briefTitle: A Study Comparing GSK2118436 to Dacarbazine (DTIC) in Previously Untreated Subjects With BRAF Mutation Positive Advanced (Stage III) or Metastatic (Stage IV) Melanoma
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Randomized, Open-label Study Comparing GSK2118436 to Dacarbazine (DTIC) in Previously Untreated Subjects With BRAF Mutation Positive Advanced (Stage III) or Metastatic (Stage IV) Melanoma

armGroups.label: GSK2118436
armGroups.description: Subjects in this arm will receive GSK2118436 150 mg twice daily.

armGroups.label: Dacarbazine (DTIC)
armGroups.description: Subjects will receive intravenous dacarbazine (DTIC) 1000 mg/m2 every 3 weeks

armGroups.label: Crossover
armGroups.description: Subjects who initially receive DTIC will be allowed to receive GSK2118436 after initial progression.

interventions.name: Dacarbazine (DTIC)
interventions.description: Intravenous (IV), 1000 mg/m2 every 3 weeks until initial progression
